section_summary.extract_value: This Discussion summarizes a single (present) study that examined whether body image flexibility mediated links between body size discrepancies and body appreciation in a pre-college sample of White older adolescent females. It highlights that effects remained when controlling for BMI, notes limitations (small racially-homogenous non-random sample, cross-sectional design, self-report BMI), and suggests future experimental and more diverse-sample research directions.
